summary: All nine round 1 findings are fixed in the committed text. F1: the published check now skips the `loops` part as its one code change, and the st2/1 detail stays fixed. F2: `loops-minutes` compares with `meta.periodMinutes`, and the plan adds the 49-minute Level 3 case. F3: FR-6 now defines the taught set per card kind, and the plan adds one pass and one fail case for each kind. F4: the print track paragraph states the serialization rule, and Phase 2 Green waits for the print track proof commit. F5: the refine `StorytimeLoopsApprovalSchema` needs `words` and `date` on an approved part, with four refine cases. F6 to F9 are fixed as responded. The code citations check out: the published filter (checks.ts lines 319-323) excludes only `print`; `taughtTo` (lines 54-63) holds graphemes, tricky, and programWeek; the app part has no refine; `StripCardSchema` matches the recall shape; `BookPageSchema.text` grounds the `answer.word` rule; `SCRIPT_IDS_LEVEL1` matches FR-8. Every teach week w01 to w07 has tricky words and the steps A6 and D2, so FR-4 applies as written. One new Major: FR-6 leaves the term 'the text of a day' undefined for `word` cards, so the pass set of `loops-recall` for word cards is an open implementer decision. No CONTEST items exist; all nine responses were FIX.

paraphrase.proposes: The track adds five teaching routines from research item A-42 to the Storytime Level 2 weeks: an oral blend drill on step A4, a correct-practise-retest loop on the sound steps A1 to A3, a fast-way sight-word step with a timed check on A6 and D2, a fixed set of three questions on each read-along, and a daily recall of five cards in the opening. New optional schema fields carry the routines, and the new approval part `loops` gets its own refine that needs `words` and `date` on an approved part. Six new checks gate the routines with the status warn until the content of weeks 1 to 8 lands, then fail; the checks compare the day total with `meta.periodMinutes`, and they skip Level 1. The published check skips the `loops` part like the `print` part, so the accepted FAIL detail of st2/1 stays as it is. The teacher manual prints the routines only with the new `--loops` option, so the approved week 1 proof of 2026-11-05 stays byte-equal. Daniel approves the English and Thai text before the release proof of 2026-11-20, and the loops take their minutes from the donor steps so the day stays 30 minutes.
paraphrase.current_system: A week file holds meta, focus, books, song, five daily scripts with steps, review strips, the Friday check, and approvals (schema.ts). checkStorytimeWeek (checks.ts) runs the rules and receives the known weeks, and check-weeks.ts prints the reports per level. The published check iterates every approval part except `print` (checks.ts lines 319-323), so the one accepted FAIL today is the published row of st2/1 with the detail `images not approved; audio not approved; song not approved`. `taughtTo` (lines 54-63) holds the taught graphemes, the tricky words, and the program week of the week and its earlier weeks. manual.ts renders the teacher book HTML from the week, and make-manual-pdf.ts and make-teacher-book-print.ts build the Thai teacher book PDF; make-teacher-book-print.ts exits 2 on an unknown flag. The opening is a fixed 6-minute routine, and the recall of a day prints the moved steps of the day before. Only Level 2 weeks (w01 to w08) exist in content today.

nonblocking_findings: F10 [Major] spec FR-6 (word cards): Comprehension gap: FR-6 says a `word` card "appears in the text of an earlier day of the same week, or in the text of an earlier week", but no section defines "the text of a day". The plan repeats the phrase in its word-card test cases (plan Phase 1 Red 2), so the check author must decide which strings count: the English lines of the day's steps only, or also the prep lines, the Thai lines, or the reader page text that the day's read-along step reads. The two readings give different pass sets for `loops-recall`, so this leaves an implementer decision open. The author reads it as the English lines of the day's steps; that reading needs one sentence in FR-6 (and it decides that reader page text does not count). Rationale: an undefined project-specific term that decides the check result.
